newsitem.title: USA: Italian Oven to sell assets for $3.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Italian Oven to sell assets for $3.5 mln.

text.p: The Italian Oven Inc said on Friday it signed a letter of intent to sell substantially all of its assets to The Whitecliff Group Inc for about $3.5 million.
The commpany said the parties would sign a definitive agreement for the deal later this month.
Whitecliff is a Minneapolis-based merchant banker funded by private equity with interests in real estate and hotels, the company said.
The Italian Oven, which operates and franchises Italian-theme restaurants, is currently functioning under Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection.
